turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why is there a zero in my son's gradebook, and why did I find out about it from him?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Record it. I'll want a copy afterward, and I'm taking my own notes. Now answer my question, Hale.
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.

I haven't said a word about legal action. I asked why there's a zero in the gradebook, and I'm still waiting for an answer. I'm writing down that you raised a harassment complaint before answering it.
I always do. That's twenty years of habit, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
